rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the animal.

example.english: That lion in the zoo is very big.
example.traditional: 動物園入面嗰隻獅子好大隻。
example.jyutping: dung6 mat6 jyun4 jap6 min6 go2 zek3 si1 zi2 hou2 daai6 zek3

rows.note: Use this for the figurative sense of a person admired for bravery or strength rather than for the animal itself.

example.english: This firefighter risked his life to save people; they are truly a lion.
example.traditional: 呢位消防員冒住生命救人，真係一名勇士。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 siu1 fong4 jyun4 mou6 zyu6 sang1 ming6 gau3 jan4 zan1 hai6 jat1 ming4 jung5 si6

rows.note: Use this when the reference is a famous person regarded as a celebrity or social attraction.

example.english: That lion attracted a big crowd as soon as they appeared.
example.traditional: 嗰位名人一出場，就吸引咗大班人影相。
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 ming4 jan4 jat1 ceot1 coeng4 zau6 kap1 jan5 zo2 daai6 baan1 jan4 jing2 soeng2
